#| tbl-cap: "Participants in MPX NYC Study by Sex / Physical Contact in Congregate Setting in past 4 weeks"
#| label: tbl-descriptives-by-groupsex

list_labels_groupSex_table1 <- targets::tar_read(initial_settings)$labels_list


table_1_descriptives <- targets::tar_read(data_table_1_people_by_groupSex_raw) %>%
                                mutate(stratum = stratum_groupSex) %>%
                                dplyr::group_by(variable) %>%
                                dplyr::mutate(var_label = c(variable[1], rep(NA, length(variable) - 1))) %>%
                                dplyr::ungroup() %>%
                                mpxnyc::draw_table_1(list_labels_groupSex_table1)

table_1_descriptives
